newsitem.title: USA: US Dec S&P 500 posts sharp gains amid tech rally.
newsitem.headline: US Dec S&P 500 posts sharp gains amid tech rally.

text.p: U.S. December Standard and Poor's 500 futures charged through several layers of resistance and posted sharp gains, in sync with powerful rallies in technology stocks and year-end euphoria.
After a wild ride late last week that saw stocks and bonds post huge losses and then recover slightly, U.S. markets regained their composure Monday.
"This is really looking good," one S&P trader said. He noted buy-stops above 745.50 and 749.30 in December and said buy programs were triggered above 2.00 points premium to cash.
Traders said year-end buying aided the rally.

Traders also said U.S. markets decisively shed worries about "irrational exuberance" that Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan spawned last week. Traders said fears of an imminent rate hike ebbed and bullish momentum returned.
"We swept (Greenspan's comments) right under the rug," another trader said.

December broke above Friday's 745.50 high early, triggering buy-stops and chart momentum that carried the contract above Thursday's 749.30 high. Aggressive demand from several Wall Street firms extended the gains amid a frenzy of buying that propelled the contract to the 751.90 session high.
Nikkei 225 futures extended their gains late and saw very good buying as Dec S&Ps extended their rally, a Nikkei trader said.

At settlement, December S&Ps were up 11.00 at 751.50, new composites were up 4.90 at 395.75, Value Lines rose 8.65 at 687.90, Nikkeis were 235 higher at 20,730, Midcaps were up 3.95 at 257.80 and Nasdaqs were 28.10 higher at 858.35. ((Derivatives desk 312-408-8750;E-mail derivatives@reuters.com))
"The Nasdaq and Russell were strong and that held us up," one S&P trader said. "And of course there was a very firm interest rate market."
The Nasdaq composite index hit an unofficial record high of 1316.28, outstripping the previous high set December 3 at 1313.38
Traders also noted good buying in March S&Ps that spilled into December.
Ceilings in December S&Ps were now seen at the all-time high settlement from November 25 at 759.65, the two-week high at 763.95 and the all-time high at 765.30, chartists said.
